description: NVDA add-on for OCR, AI-powered image description, automatic recognition, and AI-assisted computer control.
changelog:
### 0.6.5

* Improved settings and follow-up dialog layouts, including high-DPI scaling.
* Improved editing of long custom and automatic-recognition prompts.
* Improved follow-up questions so initial descriptions and latest answers can be viewed as formatted content.

translations.description: 为 NVDA 提供 OCR、AI 图像描述、自动识别和 AI 辅助计算机控制的插件。
translations.changelog:
### 0.6.5

* 改进设置和追问对话框的布局，包括高 DPI 缩放。
* 改进较长的自定义提示词和自动识别提示词的编辑体验。
* 改进追问功能，现在可以以格式化内容查看初始描述和最新回答。
